title: Context-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model for Document Question Answering
programme: Final Year Project 1 · Bachelor of Computer Science (BCS)
institution: Kulliyyah of Information & Communication Technology, International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM)
supervisor: Prof. Dr. Amelia Ritahani Binti Ismail
abstract: Document Question Answering requires extracting precise answers from long, unstructured documents. LLMs are limited by frozen training knowledge, context-window constraints, and hallucination. Standard RAG grounds generation in retrieved passages but its top-k retrieval bottleneck can exclude evidence spread across a document. This project implements and evaluates CA-RAG, which removes the retrieval filter entirely and instead validates each candidate answer against its source chunk using cosine similarity or dot product after generation. Two chunking strategies (semantic, fixed-size) and two embedding models (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Contriever-msmarco) are crossed on TriviaQA and SQuAD, evaluated by BERTScore. Semantic chunking with Contriever and dot-product scoring gives the strongest TriviaQA result (F1 = 0.7941); the embedding model is the dominant factor, with MiniLM filtering collapsing under the fixed tau = 0.6 threshold while Contriever stays competitive.
objectives: Develop a CA-RAG model using semantic and fixed chunking strategies for document question answering.
Enhance the CA-RAG model with cosine and dot-product similarity methods for retrieving relevant contextual information.
Analyse CA-RAG performance using retrieval and generation evaluation metrics.
problem_statement: Standard RAG relies on a top-k retriever that selects only a few chunks before generation. When the evidence for a question is spread across multiple sections of a long document, the retriever often excludes relevant chunks and the LLM is forced to answer from incomplete context, producing incomplete or hallucinated responses. There is no built-in mechanism to verify whether a generated answer is actually grounded in the source text.

community_impacts.detail: Query clinical guidelines & research; grounded answers reduce the risk of misinformation.
Search contracts & case documents; only context-backed answers are returned for legal accuracy.
Answer questions from textbooks; students & teachers query long papers in seconds.
